items.title: 56799_Red Norvo oral history interview
items.q: I tell you who put us together, first. A guy -- an old band leader by the name of Will Osborne.

ctx.x: Yeah, and we worked with Mavis at Vegas, oh a lot of
places out West. Different places, gambling places and -- in Tahoe, Wagon Wheel -- and I tell you who put us together, first. A guy -- an old band leader by the name of Will Osborne.
Will Osborne -- it was around Rudy Vallee's time and the day -- he was the booker at the Wagon Wheel and in Tahoe.
